rounds.response: For our end-of-quarter initial launch, success means achieving zero data discrepancies on invoices across all channels and reducing our billing-related support ticket volume by at least 20%. We are explicitly deferring complex features like self-serve tier upgrades or custom discounting workflows to a later phase so we can guarantee delivery of the core experience. This scoped approach ensures we directly resolve the primary mid-market pain points regarding consistency and ownership without overextending the team. I am locking in this scope today and will draft the formal PRD focusing solely on these two pillars.
